items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 你好，我是阿罗夏，一个猎人。当然，如果你去路匪那边打听，就可能会知道我的另一个身份——先把这个当成我们之间的秘密吧。
items.text_en: Hello, I'm Alyosha. I'm a hunter — though if you've talked to any highwaymen, you might've heard a different side to my story. But anyway, let's keep that between us for now.

items.title: 闲聊·枪法
items.text: 打靶练出来的枪法和打猎练出来的枪法，完全不能相提并论。当然，还有一种枪法是打仗练出来的，嗯…不说也罢。
items.text_en: When it comes to honing your marksmanship, target practice and actual hunting are two different beasts. Then, of course, there's the skills you pick up in battle... That's a whole other story.

items.title: 闲聊·领养
items.text: 你想领养小狗吗？有想法的话一定要来找我，什么品种的都有。给你领养，我放心。
items.text_en: If you ever want to adopt a dog, come find me. I've got all kinds of breeds, and I know that any of them would be in good hands with you.

items.title: 闲聊·算账
items.text: 这一笔寄回老家，这一笔交给社里的人去买药，那保养猎枪要用的摩拉…看看这次又轮到哪一伙路匪倒霉了。
items.text_en: This amount goes back home, and this is for the Rokot to buy medicine. Now I just need to find enough for gun maintenance... Heh, let's see which gang of highwaymen are out of luck this time...

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 兜帽要湿透了…图加林，别甩毛！
items.text_en: My hood's getting soaked... Oh no, Tugarin! Don't shake!

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 藏在洞里的家伙要出来了。
items.text_en: Time for the prey to crawl out of its hiding place...

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 想埋伏别人吗？正好可以借着雷声的掩护放冷枪。
items.text_en: Perfect weather for an ambush, if you had anyone in mind... I can use the sound of the thunder to mask my gunshots.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 啧，猎物的痕迹要被覆盖掉了。
items.text_en: Tch, tracking is going to be impossible in this.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 这种天气，根本没办法戴帽子…
items.text_en: No wearing a hood in this weather...

items.title: 在沙漠的时候
items.text: 要是我也能褪毛就好了…
items.text_en: Wish I could shed some fur too...

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 每天早上，林子里的鸟都会叽叽喳喳的…要不要去打两只下来？
items.text_en: Hear that? That's the birds chirping away in the woods, like they do every morning... Why don't we go shoot a couple down?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 我的午饭一般是在野外吃，但我不建议你也这样。
items.text_en: I usually eat lunch out in the wild, but I wouldn't exactly recommend it.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 入夜了，很多珍奇的猎物总是在这个时候才会出来活动。
items.text_en: Some of the rarest prey only come out at night.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 你先休息吧，我这边还有些事情只能晚上做。
items.text_en: Go ahead and rest. I still have things to do, and I need the cover of night.

items.title: 关于阿罗夏自己·图加林
items.text: 第一次见到图加林的时候，这小家伙被遗弃在雪地里，缩成一团，爬都爬不起来。不过它命挺硬，被喂了两根香肠，就能围着我打转了。倒不是我的口粮已经多到可以拿来养宠物了，只是一位猎人不能没有猎犬，不是吗？
items.text_en: When I first stumbled on Tugarin, the little guy had been abandoned in the snow. He was curled up in a ball and couldn't even move. He's a tough one, though. I fed him a couple sausages, and he was up, running circles around me in no time. It's not like I have the rations to spare for a pet, but... What's a hunter without a hunting dog?

items.title: 关于阿罗夏自己·猎枪
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启这把猎枪最初是父亲交给我的，后来被我整体改装了一遍。要我说，牵扯到身家性命的武器，无论是捡来的，抢来的，还是买来的，都不靠谱。这可是一起拼命的伙计，我必须了解它的每一个零部件。不过，枪械的保养和改装确实是一笔不小的开销，有时候得饿两顿才能填上这个窟窿…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My father gave me this hunting rifle back in the day, but I've completely revamped it since then. Whether a weapon is scavenged, stolen, or bought, it can be the only thing standing between you and certain death, and that's always a risk. I'm putting my life on the line with this thing, so I have to know it like the back of my hand, down to its smallest component. Of course, maintenance and modification don't come cheap. If it takes skipping a couple meals to cover the cost, so be it...

items.title: 关于我们·猎人与冒险家
items.text: 完成「雪原上的猎手」剧情就像我说的那样，面对未知的荒野，猎人捕获猎物后就会回头，而冒险家总是喜欢走得更远一些。正因如此，那些惊天动地的大事很少和我这种猎人扯上关系。不过，偶尔听你这样的冒险家讲一讲那些惊险的故事，也算是个有趣的消遣。
items.text_en: Complete "Hunter on the Snowfields"With the sprawling wilderness before them, a hunter turns back after catching their prey, but an adventurer always goes that extra step further. That's why you're the one with a list of epic deeds a mile long, and not me. That said, listening to you talk about all your thrilling adventures certainly isn't a bad way to pass the time.

items.title: 关于我们·理想
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启完成「雪原上的猎手」剧情你觉得至冬最终会变成一个什么样的国家呢？呵…我还是第一次和别人谈起这个问题。无论是正在为下一顿饭发愁的村民，还是忙着算计过客的路匪，都不会有闲心去跟我讨论这个问题。你的话，就正合适。不过，不必现在就交换答案，我还想仔细考虑一下。毕竟，这个问题的答案就是平时被我们称作「理想」的东西吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Hunter on the Snowfields"What kind of nation do you think Snezhnaya will become? Heh... Y'know, I've never asked anyone that before. The villagers are too busy worrying where their next meal is coming from, and the highwaymen are too preoccupied with their next scam. No one has the time to entertain that kind of talk. But, you're the perfect person to ask. We don't need to swap answers right now, though. I still want to give it some thought. After all, I suppose it's just a different way of asking what "ideal" we aspire to.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我听人说，「神之眼」代表了一个人的愿望。但是「愿望」这两个字实在太虚浮了，我只关心它能给我带来哪些实际的帮助。如果不是发现它能增强我的特殊能力，我恐怕已经把它拿去换成摩拉了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4People often say that a Vision is supposed to represent your deepest wishes. But that kind of pointless, fluffy thinking couldn't be more meaningless to me. All I care about is what this trinket can do for me. If I never discovered that it made me more powerful, I probably would have traded it for Mora by now.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 在至冬的雪原上行走，会说黑话是一种很重要的技能。万一遇到了妖精帮派或者路匪，嘴皮子利索一点，就能给自己省去很多麻烦。对了，要是碰上了一群总是在念叨「鸡肉」的家伙，直接洗劫他们就是。「鸡肉」指的是没什么威胁，但是随身携带少量财物的路人。只敢对「鸡肉」动手的家伙，是路匪当中的废物，凭你我的身手两三下就能收拾掉。对，这算是黑吃黑，这帮人不敢报告给冬契军，只能吃哑巴亏。
items.text_en: When you're off the beaten path in Snezhnaya, knowing the local code is an important skill. If you run into certain fae or highwaymen, being able to talk the talk can save you a lot of trouble. Oh, and if you ever encounter a group of people who keep muttering about "chicken," go ahead and rob them blind. "Chicken" is code for a harmless civilian carrying a small amount of valuables. Basically, an easy target. The people who go after them are the worst of the worst, but they're no match for us. Plus, considering their own criminal record, they wouldn't even dream of reporting us to the Druzhna, so they just have to take it.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 我很早就听说过，在蒙德城有一家猫尾酒馆，提瓦特各地的七圣召唤高手都会前往那里切磋牌技。如果有机会出国，我第一个想去的地方就是那里。唯一的缺点是，蒙德距离这里实在太远了…唉，为什么至冬就没有这样的酒馆呢？
items.text_en: I've heard there's a tavern in Mondstadt called The Cat's Tail, where Genius Invokation TCG masters from all over Teyvat go to face off. If I ever get the chance to travel abroad, that's the first place I wanna go. I just wish Mondstadt wasn't so far from here... *sigh* Why doesn't Snezhnaya have a place like that?

items.title: 关于「女皇」陛下
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启对于我来说，女皇陛下就像是落在这大地上的雪，她让我们承受彻骨的寒冷，她也帮我们埋葬了恼人的污秽。不知道她哪一天才会垂下怜爱，让我这个雪国之子也有幸能看一眼冰雪融化之后的至冬国。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4To me, Her Majesty the Tsaritsa is like the snow that covers this land. She brings a bitter cold we have no choice but to endure, but she also provides a buffer against the darker things in this world. Will any child of this frozen land ever see it thawed...? I do wonder if the Tsaritsa will ever grant that mercy...

items.title: 关于奥黛塔
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情最初得知奥黛塔也是呼啸社的成员时，我很惊讶，谁能想到愚人众的成员里也会有人认同呼啸社的理念？不过既然如此，实现那个理想的难度应该没有我想象中的那么大，这个国家的未来仍然值得期待。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"I was very surprised to learn that Odette was part of the Rokot. I never thought a member of the Fatui would share our principles... But, now that I've been proven wrong, I'm starting to think that making the changes we want to see might not be as difficult as I imagined. A brighter future for this nation is still within our grasp.

items.title: 关于沃雅妮莎
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情沃雅妮莎是呼啸社重要的情报来源，我经常找她打听事情，她提供的情报对我的帮助很大。不过，不谈公事的时候，我常常搞不清楚她在想什么，倒是奥黛塔和她交流起来就自然多了…难道女孩子之间也有黑话？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"Vodyanitsa is a vital source of intelligence for the Rokot. Whenever I go to her for information, she's always a huge help. When we're not talking business, though, I can barely make heads or tails of what she's trying to say. But Odette doesn't seem to have that problem. Those two get on like it's the most natural thing in the world... Makes me wonder if girls have some kind of secret code...

items.title: 关于瓦列里
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启第一次遇到瓦列里的时候，他挡在我跟前，说根据什么什么条令的第多少条，我不得接近军械宫，因此要将我驱离…正常来说，他看到了一个扛着猎枪潜行到军械宫附近的家伙，不应该直接将其抓捕吗？我都已经准备打一架了。不过，没打起来的那一架，让我在军械宫里多了一个熟人。在某些方面，他的想法跟我很合拍。我和他划了一条明确的线，只要不越过这条线，我们就能相处得很愉快。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The first time I met Valeriy, he blocked my path and turned me away from the Armory Palace, listing off some article of some regulation or other that said I wasn't allowed to approach... I mean, I was sneaking around with a hunting rifle no less, so I was surprised the guy didn't arrest me on the spot. In fact, I was expecting to have to fight him off, but instead, I gained a new contact at the Armory. Not a bad turn of events. Honestly, we think alike in a lot of ways. So now that we've established a clear boundary, as long as it isn't crossed, we get along great.

items.title: 关于米提亚
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情我没有正经读过书，所以我以为自己和米提亚这样的人会很难相处，后来他主动帮我改装了几次枪械之后，我才明白这样的担心十分多余。米提亚这个人很好说话，只要把他当成一个邻家少年就行。唯一需要注意的点，可能就是在他念叨那些「科学黑话」的时候，不要打扰他。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"I've never really had much formal schooling, so I thought it would be hard to get along with someone like Mitya. But he's helped me modify my rifle more than once, without me even having to ask, so clearly I was worried for nothing. Mitya is easy to talk to. I just treat him like any other neighbor, and it works out fine. Word to the wise, though... If he's off on one of his science tangents, steer clear.

items.title: 想要了解阿罗夏·其一
items.text: 你想知道我的秘密？目前的话，我只能告诉你，「猎人」这个身份是一个很好用的伪装。
items.text_en: Trying to get me to spill my secrets, huh? Fine. You can have one, but that's it: Being a "hunter" is a very useful disguise.

items.title: 想要了解阿罗夏·其二
items.text: 好感等级达到3后开启曾有人问过我，瞄准一只动物和瞄准一个人，有什么区别？我没有回答。我坚信这两者之间是有区别的，但是随着开枪的次数越来越多，我发现无论瞄准的是动物还是人，我扣动扳机的动作已经不再发生变化…所以我并不喜欢将枪口对准一个人，我害怕有一天那种区别会从我心里消失。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Someone once asked me if there's a difference between pointing a gun at an animal versus a person. I didn't answer at the time, but I firmly believe there is one. It's just, the more shots I fire, the more that line gets blurred, and the more the motion of pulling the trigger starts to feel the same, no matter who I'm aiming at... So, I take no pleasure in pointing my gun at people. Sometimes I wonder what will happen if that line disappears one day, and that scares me.

items.title: 想要了解阿罗夏·其三
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我小时候，家里遭到了一群强盗的洗劫，所有财物都被抢走了。虽然父母都安慰我说没有大碍，但我明白失去了这些财物对我的家来说意味着什么。我利用自己的能力，追踪那伙强盗。那是我第一次狩猎动物以外的目标，我的手沾上了鲜血…我并不后悔，那伙强盗穷凶极恶，应当付出代价，只是我发现他们也是一群穷困潦倒的家伙。从那时起，我逐渐明白，这个国家最大的问题并不是这些强盗。如果不能找到这个国家真正的问题所在，我手上的鲜血就没有任何意义。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When I was a kid, a gang of thugs ransacked my home and stole all our belongings. My parents tried to brush it off and say that we'd be fine, but I knew what losing all we had meant for our family. So, I decided to put my skills as a hunter to good use, and for the first time, my target wasn't an animal. Now, their blood is on my hands, and I don't regret it. They deserved to pay for what they did. It turns out, though, they were as poor and destitute as we were, driven to desperation by circumstances beyond their control. That's when I realized: Thugs and robbers aren't the real problem with this country, and if we can't figure out what it is, the blood on my hands is for nothing.

items.title: 想要了解阿罗夏·其四
items.text: 好感等级达到5后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情我当初决定加入呼啸社，是因为我觉得它的理念很适用于现在的至冬。不过，我也明白，这样的理念总有一天会不再适用于至冬。等我们为之奋斗的一切终于有了结果之后，很多事物都会发生变化——那时候，真正的考验才刚刚开始。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"I decided to join the Rokot because I feel like the principles we're fighting for are exactly what Snezhnaya needs right now. But I know, one day, that will no longer be the case. Once we get what we've been fighting for, a lot of things will change, and that's when the real test begins.

items.title: 想要了解阿罗夏·其五
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启在我看来，「现实主义者」可能是这个世界上最市侩的人，他们永远盯着钱，盯着权，盯着每个人心里那点腌臜事。另一方面，「理想主义者」可能是这个世界上最清高的人，看不起偷，看不起骗，眼里容不下一点沙子。其实还有一种人，叫做「现实理想主义者」，夹在那两者之间，每天都过得很拧巴。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6In my eyes, realists are some of the most self-centered, opportunistic people in the world, always fixated on profit, power, or what the people around them might be hiding. Idealists, on the other hand, might be some of the most noble among us. No tolerance for lying, stealing, or the slightest injustice. There's actually a third type of person, though — the "realistic idealist." Caught in the middle, they live every day constantly pulled in opposite directions.

items.title: 阿罗夏的爱好
items.text: 改装，保养，试射…我原本觉得自己对于枪械的关心是出于战斗的需要，但发现自己总是会投入过多的时间和摩拉之后，我不得不承认我已经把它当成爱好了。
items.text_en: Modifying, maintaining, and testing my rifle... I used to think firearm care was out of pure necessity. But considering how much time and Mora I pour into it, I suppose it's time to admit it's become something of a passion, too.

items.title: 阿罗夏的烦恼
items.text: 改装要花的摩拉，保养要花的摩拉，试射要花的摩拉…只要好好算账，人们就会发现，最大的爱好可能就是最大的烦恼。
items.text_en: Now that would be all the Mora I spend on modifying, maintaining, and testing my rifle... Do the math, and you might just realize the things you love the most in life are also the source of all your problems.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 腌渍好的肉，耐储存的面包，一烤就融化的奶酪…有了这些好东西，哪怕在冰天雪地里，只要生起火，我就能张罗一顿大餐。
items.text_en: Cured meat, long-lasting bread, cheese that melts when toasted... With those ingredients, all I need is a fire, and I always have a feast at my fingertips, even when surrounded by ice and snow.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 我很不喜欢吃带壳的东西，螃蟹，龙虾，诸如此类。花那么多摩拉，费那么多力气，跟钳子和尖刺搏斗，就为了那一点点肉？既不划算，也不痛快。
items.text_en: Anything with a shell. Crabs, lobsters... things like that. They cost an arm and a leg, you practically have to wrestle their pincers and spikes just to get them open, and after all that, there's barely any meat inside. It's not worth the cost or the effort.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 谢谢，真不错…这种食物有办法存放起来以后继续吃吗？
items.text_en: Thanks, it's delicious... Does this keep well? I think I'll finish it later.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 嗯…要不要让我向你介绍几种稀有的野味？添加一些更高级的食材，这份料理肯定能更好吃。
items.text_en: Hmm... Why don't I help you get your hands on some rare wild game? Higher-quality ingredients would make this even better.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: …不能浪费粮食，雪原上的村落里，肯定有人比我更需要这份食物。
items.text_en: ...Well, can't let food go to waste. I'm sure there's a villager who needs this more than I do.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 今天是你的生日吧？请让我送上自己的祝贺。从我记事起，「过生日」在大人眼里一直是一种很奢侈的事，不但要找来紧缺的面粉和奶油制作蛋糕，还要去搜刮那些早就从市场里绝迹的精致小物件，用来当作礼物。不过，我认为错不在孩子们，生日就该是这个样子。我希望有一天，全至冬的孩子都能这样过生日。所以我认真准备了礼物，写好了贺词。让自己的好朋友能度过一个愉快的生日，这对我刚刚夸下海口的那个理想来说，算是一个不错的开始，不是吗？
items.text_en: Happy Birthday. It is today, isn't it? Y'know, where I come from, birthday celebrations are usually a luxury we can't afford. Good luck scrounging up enough flour and cream for a cake, or finding someone who sells anything but the bare essentials to use as a gift. But, I'll never begrudge a kid for wanting to celebrate their birthday. That's how it should be, and one day, I hope no child in Snezhnaya has to go without. So, I've decided to take your birthday very seriously, and I've put a lot of thought into the gift and card I got for you. Sometimes, you have to be the change you want to see in the world, right?

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 突破等级「1」阶后开启很好，感觉我的枪法更准了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Nice. Feels like my aim is more accurate.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 突破等级「2」阶后开启和图加林的配合更默契了，这家伙也在进步啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Tugarin's getting better too. Seems like we're more in sync.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 突破等级「4」阶后开启命中的次数更多了…这究竟是好事，还是坏事？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4For better or for worse, my shots aren't going to miss now.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 突破等级「6」阶后开启为了实现那个理想，还有多远的路要走呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6How much further must we go until the world we're fighting for becomes a reality?

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 枪更快！
items.text_en: Gun it!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 中！
items.text_en: Bullseye!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 倒！
items.text_en: One down!

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 藏好了吗？
items.text_en: Ready or not...

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 标记猎物。
items.text_en: Prey spotted.

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: 抓到你了。
items.text_en: Gotcha.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 接好了，图加林！
items.text_en: Here, boy!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 图加林，游戏时间！
items.text_en: Tugarin, fetch!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 跑得过猎犬吗？
items.text_en: It's dog-eat-dog!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 好好看看，可别漏了什么。
items.text_en: Take a good look. Don't wanna miss anything.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 有什么能换摩拉的好东西吗？
items.text_en: Anything I can trade for some Mora?

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 收好就走，小心让坏人盯上。
items.text_en: Grab it and go. Before we get tailed.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 这样下去，要失温了…
items.text_en: The cold's getting to me...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 得先找个掩体…
items.text_en: I should find cover...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 要考虑医药费的事了…
items.text_en: Think about the medical bills...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 先退后，我掩护！
items.text_en: Fall back! I'll cover you!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 别拼命，猎物有我盯着。
items.text_en: Take it easy. I'll finish them off.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 这次我才是猎物吗？
items.text_en: My hunting days... are over...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 图加林，快跑…
items.text_en: Tugarin, run...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 要是能更快开枪的话…
items.text_en: Shoulda drawn... faster...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 不划算…
items.text_en: Hope it was worth it...

items.title: 普通受击·其二
items.text: 擦伤而已。
items.text_en: Only grazed me.

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 还挺凶…
items.text_en: That one hurt...

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 谁放的冷枪？
items.text_en: Cheap shot...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 狩猎开始。
items.text_en: Let the hunt begin.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 枪弹上膛。
items.text_en: All geared up.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 猎物在哪？
items.text_en: Eyes on the prize.
